notes:
PhoneBridge 0.6.0 makes setup easier and adds visible actions and saved history.

- Windows installer includes its runtime, finds the local network, starts the service and displays pairing. Copy the ready-to-use MCP configuration from the computer panel. An optional LAN button requests Windows approval once for the private local network.
- Remember several computers on the phone and switch by name. Each computer keeps its own action permissions; one connection is active at a time.
- See AI taps, holds and swipes as brief blue trails. Enabled by default, with a saved Settings switch; excluded from screenshots.
- Operation history is saved locally and readable by AI with `phone_operation_history`. It records timing, actions and reported outcomes, excluding typed text, screen contents, images and credentials.
- Chinese/English App and website, direct APK/Windows downloads, Obtainium import, and verified release distribution workflow.

Windows 双击安装即可使用，不用装 Node.js 或找 IP；电脑面板可直接复制 AI 的 MCP 配置。手机可记住多台电脑并按名称切换。操作轨迹默认开启，设置可关闭；电脑保存操作日志，AI 可读取，升级保留原配对与授权。

Verified on the existing Android 16 phone and Windows computer. Two local desktop endpoints were tested; two physical computers and cross-network access were not tested. APK uses the existing preview debug signer; Windows executables are unsigned. Uptodown approval is separate from this release. See [verification](https://github.com/JevonsCode/phonebridge/blob/main/docs/verification.md) and [installation](https://github.com/JevonsCode/phonebridge/blob/main/docs/agent-install.md).
